- Inspected startup manager metrics setup, nsxclient request/list paths, kubeapi typed REST client, and stateoperator manager snapshot/plan flow.
- Found controller-runtime metrics endpoint already exists but is disabled by BindAddress "0" in startup; Prometheus client deps are already present indirectly.
- Planning direction: add a small internal metrics package, instrument NSX/Kubernetes HTTP boundaries and stateoperator list-groups summary boundary, test via public metrics scrape/registry behavior, then verify with nsx-t-mockapi and envtest.
- Next: create .ralph task plan file, update task with plan path and NOW EXECUTE, then stop as instructed.

- Updated the task with the plan path and <execution_state>NOW EXECUTE</execution_state>.
- Per instructions for the planning phase, stop immediately; next agent should read the task, see NOW EXECUTE, read the tdd skill, execute the plan, and run all required checks before marking passes true.

- Read previous progress, current task, task file, and execution plan.
- Confirmed execution_state is NOW EXECUTE, so proceeding with TDD implementation rather than planning.
- Worktree already has Ralph task/progress files from previous planning pass; preserve and build on them.
- Next: implement first RED/GREEN slice for internal/operatormetrics private registry behavior.

- Added internal/operatormetrics package with Recorder interface, NopRecorder, PrometheusRecorder, manager snapshot gauges, NSX/Kubernetes counters, byte counters, and histograms.
- Added private-registry metrics test verifying low-cardinality counter/gauge series and histogram series counts.
- Ran go test ./internal/operatormetrics successfully.
- Next: add NSX client behavior test, then instrument NSX request boundary with manager/function labels and byte/duration accounting.

- Added NSX client metrics test for public ListGroups and PatchGroup calls through httptest server.
- Instrumented nsxclient with optional operatormetrics.Recorder, manager label fallback, client call counters, HTTP request/byte counters, and whole body-read duration histograms.
- Added bounded nsxFunction mapping for existing route families instead of using raw paths as labels.
- Ran go test ./internal/nsxclient -run TestClientRecordsNSXMetricsForPublicCalls -count=1 successfully.
- Next: add Kubernetes typed client metric test and instrument REST request boundary.

- Added Kubernetes typed-client metrics test using envtest and public Groups Create/List/Update/UpdateStatus/Delete calls.
- Added kubeapi.Options.Recorder and transport-level instrumentation on copied rest.Config, with bounded labels like groups.create/groups.list/groups.update_status.
- Direct go test ./internal/kubeapi -run TestTypedClientRecordsKubernetesAPIMetrics compiles but cannot run outside make because KUBEBUILDER_ASSETS is unset, matching existing kubeapi tests.
- Next: add stateoperator manager-sweep gauge test and wire recorder through stateoperator/startup.

- Wired metrics recorder through stateoperator.Options and defaultManagerSweep; added manager snapshot gauge summary from ManagerSnapshot + ManagerPlan.
- Added stateoperator integration assertion for listed/observe/manage/update/create gauges in the existing default manager sweep test.
- Added operator.metricsBindAddress config parsing with default :8080 for loaded configs, startup metrics endpoint wiring, and compose port exposure.
- Wired one process-scoped Prometheus recorder into startup for kubeapi/nsxclient/stateoperator to avoid duplicate global registrations.
- Ran go test ./internal/operatormetrics ./internal/config ./internal/nsxclient successfully; envtest-backed kubeapi/stateoperator tests require make test assets.
- Next: run broader compile/tests, fix issues, then run required make gates.

- make check passed fmt/vet/lint/test, then failed during test-race in kubeapi watch test.
- Race was in observedResponseBody count field: watch body Read and Close can happen concurrently in client-go.
- Fixed by changing response byte count to atomic.Int64.
- Next: rerun make check from the beginning per instructions.

- Final boundary cleanup replaced hardcoded Kubernetes API group in metrics transport with nsxv1alpha.GroupName.
- Re-ran make check && make test && make test-coverage successfully after cleanup.
- make check included fmt, vet, lint, test, test-race, test-contract, test-e2e, test-large-chaos, and test-coverage; final total coverage was 83.3%.
- internal/operatormetrics package coverage is 94.9%.
- Updated task file to status done, passes true, execution_state DONE, checked acceptance criteria, and recorded representative metrics/verification evidence.
- Next: run .ralph/task_switch.sh, inspect status, add all files, commit, push.
